_comment: Directory data file — applies to every page under site/members/. Individual pages override any of these in their own front matter.
_analytics: Decided July 26, 2026: the members area gets the same analytics stack as the public site — GA4, Microsoft Clarity, and the outbound-link conversion tracker. Clarity was previously absent here (copy-paste drift in the hand-written site), which meant zero visibility into how subscribers actually use what they pay for. Note this does record session replays of logged-in subscribers; pages stay noindex so they are not publicly discoverable. To opt a single page out, set noClarity: true or noTracking: true in that page's own front matter.
